2609.19144.title: A Zeroth-Order Paradigm for LLM Preference Alignment
2609.19144.paper_summary: Direct preference alignment methods are widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because of their computational and memory efficiency. However, likelihood displacement motivates alternative ways to extract information from preference pairs with small likelihood margins. In this paper, we propose and analyze Comparison-based Preference Optimization (ComPO), a zeroth-order alignment method based on comparison oracles. ComPO extracts directional information from these pairs without directly optimizing a differentiable preference loss on them. We establish a convergence guarantee for its basic offline scheme under smoothness, gradient sparsity, and compatibility between the oracle and a latent objective. We further introduce online ComPO, which retains the offline comparison mechanism and uses unlabeled policy generations for reverse-KL control relative to a reference policy. Following the coverage perspective of preference fine-tuning, we establish a performance guarantee for a basic constrained scheme under local coverage and in-distribution pairwise reward accuracy. Experiments on Mistral, Llama, Gemma-2, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 models demonstrate improvements over existing direct alignment methods, including length-controlled win rates, with pair-level diagnostics providing evidence consistent with mitigating likelihood displacement.
2609.19144.paper_summary_zh: 直接偏好對齊方法因其計算和記憶效率而被廣泛用於將大型語言模型（LLMs）與人類偏好對齊。<lb/>然而，可能性位移激勵了從具有小可能性邊際的偏好對中提取信息的替代方法。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出並分析了基於比較的偏好優化（ComPO），這是一種基於比較預言機的零階對齊方法。<lb/>ComPO 從這些對中提取方向性信息，而不直接對它們優化可微分的偏好損失。<lb/>我們在平滑性、梯度稀疏性以及預言機與潛在目標之間的相容性下，為其基本的離線方案建立了收斂保證。<lb/>我們進一步介紹了在線 ComPO，它保留了離線比較機制，並使用未標記的策略生成進行相對於參考策略的反向 KL 控制。<lb/>根據偏好微調的覆蓋視角，我們為基本約束方案在局部覆蓋和分佈內成對獎勵準確性下建立了性能保證。<lb/>在 Mistral、Llama、Gemma-2、Qwen3 和 Gemma-3 模型上的實驗顯示，與現有的直接對齊方法相比，改進了包括長度控制的勝率在內的性能，並且成對診斷提供了與減輕可能性位移一致的證據。
